title: Capstone: AI Infrastructure & Serving Platform
description: Ship an AI serving platform: model/LLM serving with batching → monitoring → progressive rollout → failure handling. Includes load-tested autoscaling configuration, typed contracts, fault-injection evidence, and an on-call-grade runbook.
learningObjectives: Serve a model with batching and typed contracts under load
Configure and document autoscaling with evidence from load tests
Implement progressive rollout with automated rollback triggers
Demonstrate failure handling via fault injection

milestones.title: Batching serving layer
milestones.objective: Serve a model or LLM adapter with dynamic batching; document queueing latency effects.
milestones.expectedOutput: Load test showing p50/p95 across batch sizes.

milestones.title: Autoscaling configuration
milestones.objective: Provide compose/K8s manifests with scaling policy driven by measured saturation metrics.

milestones.title: Progressive rollout + rollback triggers
milestones.objective: Staged rollout with automated rollback on error-rate/latency SLO breach, verified by fault injection.
milestones.expectedOutput: Rollback demo evidence from an injected failure.

milestones.title: Fault-injection suite
milestones.objective: Inject dependency failures (model 500, timeout, queue saturation); verify graceful degradation and alerting.
milestones.expectedOutput: Fault matrix with observed behavior per failure.

categories.minimumExpectation: Two injected faults handled per policy

architecture: client → authn/ratelimit → queue/batcher → model adapter → trace export
constraints: Load tests must run in CI-sized time boxes
No cost-heavy GPU requirements; simulate or scale down honestly
hints: A 'model slower by 10x' chaos experiment is the single most revealing test you can run
